text:
alex_cs: Quick sync — Sierra wants dedicated pool next week. Need a quota "bakeoff" + autoscale plan before handoff. Who can own load tests and thresholds?

jordan_pe: I can own the load scripts and runs. When's the planned cutover? need target RPS / tokens/sec.

lee_cust: Cutover window preferred Tue->Wed morning. Targets: sustained 200 req/s, short spikes to 1200 req/s (5 min windows). Avg tokens/request ~350, p95 ~700.

maria_sre: Notes for headroom: start with min_replicas=2, max_replicas=12. Scale on p99 latency > 300ms OR queue depth > 30k tokens. Also pre-warm KV cache.

maria_sre: Autoscaler snippet:
```
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 12
  metrics:
    - type: latency_p99
      target_ms: 300
    - type: queue_tokens
      target: 30000
```

alex_cs: Jordan — can you produce a small locust script mix (chat + embeddings) and run 3 passes: low (50% load), med (100%), high (150% + spike windows)?

jordan_pe: Yep. Using locust headless. Command I'll use:
```
locust -f tests/sierra_locust.py --headless -u 400 -r 40 --run-time 15m --csv=results_pass1
```
I'll parameterize user count per pass and include token distribution.

jordan_pe: Plan is: staging preflight -> one warmup pass to populate cache -> 3 measured passes (low/med/high) -> produce perf + error + token-cost report.

devon_eng: Add routing fallback: when GPU pool>80% utilized, route requests to quantized-variant and set degrade_policy to "soft-fallback". Also ensure model version pinning for the test.

devon_eng: Route policy example:
```
routing:
  primary: model-sierra-v1
  fallback: model-sierra-v1-8bit
  fallback_threshold: 0.8
```

sam_deploybot: deploybot: Canary schedule created for dedicated pool: 2026-03-30T22:00:00Z — will notify on completion.

maria_sre: I'll own SLO dashboard & on-call during the window. On-call rotation: @maria_sre, @devon_eng, @jordan_pe. I'll set alerts for p99>300ms, error_rate>1%.

lee_cust: CS will join the test window. Preferred window 10:00-14:00 UTC. We'll validate request patterns and client-side retries.

alex_cs: Great. I'll send calendar invites with runbook + checklist. TL;DR: Wed 03/31 10:00-14:00 UTC; warmup + 3 passes; autoscaler thresholds as above; fallback policy in place. Any blockers before I lock schedule?

lee_cust: None from our side, only request: keep logs for 30 days and provide a short postmortem perf summary.

maria_sre: Acknowledged — will retain logs and produce summary within 48h.

alex_cs: Thanks team :thumbsup:
